scope: Offline cause investigation only; no model fitting, deployment, channel change, or live-label parameter selection
hypothesis: The frozen source scaler is inflated by high-energy source trials, compressing ordinary source and Cyton windows towards a class-biased near-zero model response.
falsification: Reject the outlier-dominance explanation if the highest-energy 1% of source-fitting trials account for no more than half of the total centered energy. Treat scale compression as insufficient to explain class bias if ordinary-amplitude source windows do not show the same bias.
primary_diagnostics: fixed-model left output rate in source-amplitude quartiles
source_inference: Frozen checkpoint only; report descriptive fitting and source-validation responses, not new held-out cross-person accuracy
live_sensitivity_rule: Apply every factor to every saved waveform, report all outputs without scoring cue agreement or choosing a factor. This is an unphysical diagnostic, not an approved gain correction.
source_raw_examples: Three fitting trials: two largest centered-energy trials and the median-energy trial, with ties broken by cache order. Selection is label-blind.
reset_counterfactual: Filter the 7 seconds preceding each saved window from zero state and compare to recorded continuous processing. This is a sensitivity bound, not a reconstructed original trial baseline or proof of reference equivalence.
claims_forbidden: final cause proven from seven trials
